<?php

require_once __DIR__ . '/link_network.php';

function typeName(int $type): string
{
    $names = [1 => 'A', 2 => 'NS', 5 => 'CNAME', 6 => 'SOA', 12 => 'PTR', 15 => 'MX', 16 => 'TXT', 28 => 'AAAA'];
    return $names[$type] ?? 'TYPE' . $type;
}

function rcodeName(int $code): string
{
    $names = ['NoError', 'FormErr', 'ServFail', 'NXDomain', 'NotImp', 'Refused'];
    return $names[$code] ?? 'RCODE' . $code;
}

function ipv6(array $bytes): string
{
    $groups = [];
    for ($index = 0; $index < 16; $index += 2) {
        $groups[] = uint($bytes, $index);
    }
    $bestStart = -1;
    $bestLength = 1;
    for ($index = 0; $index < 8;) {
        if ($groups[$index] !== 0) {
            $index++;
            continue;
        }
        $end = $index;
        while ($end < 8 && $groups[$end] === 0) {
            $end++;
        }
        if ($end - $index > $bestLength) {
            $bestStart = $index;
            $bestLength = $end - $index;
        }
        $index = $end;
    }
    $text = array_map(fn($value) => dechex($value), $groups);
    if ($bestStart < 0) {
        return implode(':', $text);
    }
    return implode(':', array_slice($text, 0, $bestStart)) . '::' . implode(':', array_slice($text, $bestStart + $bestLength));
}

class DnsReader
{
    private array $message;

    public function __construct(array $message)
    {
        $this->message = $message;
    }

    private function requireBytes(int $position, int $count): void
    {
        if ($position < 0 || $position + $count > count($this->message)) {
            throw new Malformed('dns: truncated');
        }
    }

    private function read(int $position, int $count = 2): int
    {
        $this->requireBytes($position, $count);
        return uint($this->message, $position, $count);
    }

    private function name(int $position): object
    {
        $labels = [];
        $after = null;
        $pointers = 0;
        while (true) {
            $length = $this->read($position, 1);
            if ($length === 0) {
                return (object) ['text' => $labels ? implode('.', $labels) : '<root>', 'after' => $after ?? $position + 1];
            }
            if ($length >= 192) {
                $low = $this->read($position + 1, 1);
                $after = $after ?? $position + 2;
                $pointers++;
                if ($pointers > 16) {
                    throw new Malformed('dns: compression loop');
                }
                $target = ($length - 192) * 256 + $low;
                if ($target >= count($this->message)) {
                    throw new Malformed('dns: pointer out of range');
                }
                $position = $target;
            } elseif ($length >= 64) {
                throw new Malformed('dns: bad label type');
            } else {
                $this->requireBytes($position + 1, $length);
                $label = '';
                for ($index = $position + 1; $index <= $position + $length; $index++) {
                    $byte = $this->message[$index];
                    $label .= $byte >= 33 && $byte <= 126 && $byte !== 46 && $byte !== 92 ? chr($byte) : '\\' . sprintf('%03d', $byte);
                }
                $labels[] = $label;
                $position += $length + 1;
            }
        }
    }

    private function rdata(int $type, int $start, int $length): object
    {
        if ($type === 1) {
            $address = $this->read($start, 4);
            return (object) ['text' => ipv4($address), 'after' => $start + 4, 'address' => $address];
        }
        if ($type === 28) {
            $this->requireBytes($start, 16);
            return (object) ['text' => ipv6(array_slice($this->message, $start, 16)), 'after' => $start + 16];
        }
        if ($type === 2 || $type === 5 || $type === 12) {
            return $this->name($start);
        }
        if ($type === 15) {
            $preference = $this->read($start);
            $target = $this->name($start + 2);
            return (object) ['text' => $preference . ' ' . $target->text, 'after' => $target->after];
        }
        if ($type === 6) {
            $primary = $this->name($start);
            $mailbox = $this->name($primary->after);
            $parts = [$primary->text, $mailbox->text];
            $position = $mailbox->after;
            for ($index = 0; $index < 5; $index++) {
                $parts[] = $this->read($position, 4);
                $position += 4;
            }
            return (object) ['text' => implode(' ', $parts), 'after' => $position];
        }
        return (object) ['text' => $length . ' bytes', 'after' => $start + $length];
    }

    public function dissect(): object
    {
        $this->requireBytes(0, 12);
        $flags = $this->read(2);
        $questions = $this->read(4);
        $counts = [$this->read(6), $this->read(8), $this->read(10)];
        $fields = ['dns.id' => [$this->read(0)], 'dns.flags' => [$flags], 'dns.flags.response' => [intdiv($flags, 32768) % 2],
            'dns.flags.opcode' => [intdiv($flags, 2048) % 16], 'dns.flags.rcode' => [$flags % 16],
            'dns.count.queries' => [$questions], 'dns.count.answers' => [$counts[0]],
            'dns.count.auth_rr' => [$counts[1]], 'dns.count.add_rr' => [$counts[2]]];
        $answers = [];
        $position = 12;
        for ($index = 0; $index < $questions; $index++) {
            $question = $this->name($position);
            $this->requireBytes($question->after, 4);
            $fields['dns.qry.name'][] = $question->text;
            $fields['dns.qry.type'][] = $this->read($question->after);
            $position = $question->after + 4;
        }
        $sections = ['dns.answer', 'dns.authority', 'dns.additional'];
        for ($section = 0; $section < 3; $section++) {
            for ($index = 0; $index < $counts[$section]; $index++) {
                $owner = $this->name($position);
                $this->requireBytes($owner->after, 10);
                $type = $this->read($owner->after);
                $recordClass = $this->read($owner->after + 2);
                $ttl = $this->read($owner->after + 4, 4);
                $length = $this->read($owner->after + 8);
                $start = $owner->after + 10;
                $this->requireBytes($start, $length);
                $value = $this->rdata($type, $start, $length);
                if ($value->after !== $start + $length) {
                    throw new Malformed('dns: bad rdata length');
                }
                $className = $recordClass === 1 ? 'IN' : 'CLASS' . $recordClass;
                $fields[$sections[$section]][] = $owner->text . ' ' . typeName($type) . ' ' . $className . ' ' . $ttl . ' ' . $value->text;
                if ($section === 0) {
                    $answers[] = (object) ['type' => $type, 'text' => $value->text];
                    if ($type === 1) {
                        $fields['dns.a'][] = $value->address;
                    }
                }
                $position = $start + $length;
            }
        }
        return (object) ['fields' => $fields, 'payload' => [], 'answers' => $answers];
    }
}

<?php

const MARKS = ['retransmission', 'out_of_order', 'lost_segment', 'duplicate_ack'];
const MODULUS = 4294967296;

function getField(object $packet, string $field): mixed
{
    return $packet->fields[$field][0] ?? null;
}

function endpointKey(array $endpoint): string
{
    return $endpoint[0] . ':' . $endpoint[1];
}

function pairKey(array $first, array $second): string
{
    $a = endpointKey($first);
    $b = endpointKey($second);
    return strcmp($a, $b) <= 0 ? $a . '|' . $b : $b . '|' . $a;
}

function newSide(): object
{
    return (object) ['isn' => null, 'mss' => null, 'ws' => null, 'base' => null, 'expected' => null, 'advanced' => null,
        'intervals' => [], 'previousAck' => null, 'packets' => 0, 'payload' => 0, 'counts' => array_fill_keys(MARKS, 0)];
}

function recordSyn(object $stream, string $side, object $packet): void
{
    $target = $stream->sides[$side];
    $target->isn = getField($packet, 'tcp.seq_raw');
    $target->mss = getField($packet, 'tcp.options.mss');
    $target->ws = getField($packet, 'tcp.options.wscale');
    $stream->handshake[$side === 'client' ? 'syn' : 'syn_ack'] = $packet->number;
}

function relativeSequence(int $value, int $base): int
{
    $difference = $value - $base;
    return ($difference < 0 ? $difference + MODULUS : $difference) % MODULUS;
}

function trackTcp(array $packets): array
{
    $streams = [];
    $latest = [];
    foreach ($packets as $packet) {
        if (getField($packet, 'tcp.srcport') === null) {
            continue;
        }
        $source = [getField($packet, 'ip.src'), getField($packet, 'tcp.srcport')];
        $destination = [getField($packet, 'ip.dst'), getField($packet, 'tcp.dstport')];
        $syn = getField($packet, 'tcp.flags.syn') === 1;
        $ackSet = getField($packet, 'tcp.flags.ack') === 1;
        $fin = getField($packet, 'tcp.flags.fin') === 1;
        $rst = getField($packet, 'tcp.flags.rst') === 1;
        $seq = getField($packet, 'tcp.seq_raw');
        $ack = getField($packet, 'tcp.ack_raw');
        $key = pairKey($source, $destination);
        $stream = $latest[$key] ?? null;
        if ($stream === null || (in_array($stream->state, ['CLOSED', 'RESET'], true) && $syn && !$ackSet)) {
            $state = $syn ? ($ackSet ? 'SYN_RECEIVED' : 'SYN_SENT') : 'ESTABLISHED';
            $stream = (object) ['number' => count($streams), 'client' => $syn && $ackSet ? $destination : $source,
                'server' => $syn && $ackSet ? $source : $destination, 'state' => $state, 'history' => [[$state, $packet->number]],
                'start' => $packet->time, 'end' => $packet->time, 'packets' => 0, 'bytes' => 0,
                'handshake' => ['syn' => null, 'syn_ack' => null, 'ack' => null], 'events' => [], 'firstCloser' => null, 'f2' => null,
                'sides' => ['client' => newSide(), 'server' => newSide()]];
            if ($syn) {
                recordSyn($stream, $ackSet ? 'server' : 'client', $packet);
            }
            $streams[] = $stream;
            $latest[$key] = $stream;
        }
        $packet->fields['tcp.stream'] = [$stream->number];
        $sideName = endpointKey($source) === endpointKey($stream->client) ? 'client' : 'server';
        $side = $stream->sides[$sideName];
        $other = $stream->sides[$sideName === 'client' ? 'server' : 'client'];
        if ($side->base === null) {
            $side->base = $seq;
        }
        if ($ackSet && $other->base === null) {
            $other->base = $ack;
        }
        $r = relativeSequence($seq, $side->base);
        $packet->fields['tcp.seq'] = [$r];
        if ($ackSet) {
            $packet->fields['tcp.ack'] = [relativeSequence($ack, $other->base)];
        }
        $length = getField($packet, 'tcp.len');
        $n = $length + (int) $syn + (int) $fin;
        $window = getField($packet, 'tcp.window');
        $mark = null;
        if ($n >= 1) {
            $interval = $r . ':' . $n;
            if ($side->expected !== null && $r > $side->expected) {
                $mark = 'lost_segment';
            }
            if ($side->expected !== null && $r < $side->expected) {
                $mark = isset($side->intervals[$interval]) || $packet->time - $side->advanced >= 3000 ? 'retransmission' : 'out_of_order';
            }
            $side->intervals[$interval] = true;
            if ($side->expected === null || $r + $n > $side->expected) {
                $side->expected = $r + $n;
                $side->advanced = $packet->time;
            }
        } elseif ($ackSet && !$rst && $side->previousAck !== null) {
            if ($ack === $side->previousAck->ack && $window === $side->previousAck->window) {
                $mark = 'duplicate_ack';
                $side->previousAck->count++;
                $packet->duplicateAck = (object) ['original' => $side->previousAck->original, 'count' => $side->previousAck->count];
            }
        }
        if ($ackSet && $mark !== 'duplicate_ack') {
            $side->previousAck = (object) ['ack' => $ack, 'window' => $window, 'original' => $packet->number, 'count' => 0];
        }
        $packet->mark = $mark;
        if ($mark !== null) {
            $packet->fields['tcp.analysis.' . $mark] = [true];
            $side->counts[$mark]++;
            $stream->events[] = [$packet->number, $sideName, $mark, $r, $n];
        }
        $packet->fields['tcp.window.calc'] = [$side->ws !== null && $other->ws !== null && !$syn ? $window * (2 ** $side->ws) : $window];
        $next = $stream->state;
        if ($rst) {
            if ($stream->state !== 'CLOSED' && $stream->state !== 'RESET') {
                $next = 'RESET';
            }
        } elseif ($stream->state === 'SYN_SENT' && $sideName === 'server' && $syn && $ackSet && $ack === ($stream->sides['client']->isn + 1) % MODULUS) {
            $next = 'SYN_RECEIVED';
            recordSyn($stream, 'server', $packet);
        } elseif ($stream->state === 'SYN_RECEIVED' && $sideName === 'client' && $ackSet && !$syn && $ack === ($stream->sides['server']->isn + 1) % MODULUS) {
            $next = 'ESTABLISHED';
            $stream->handshake['ack'] = $packet->number;
        } elseif ($stream->state === 'ESTABLISHED' && $fin) {
            $next = 'FIN_WAIT';
            $stream->firstCloser = $sideName;
        } elseif ($stream->state === 'FIN_WAIT' && $fin && $sideName !== $stream->firstCloser) {
            $next = 'CLOSING';
            $stream->f2 = ($seq + $length + 1) % MODULUS;
        } elseif ($stream->state === 'CLOSING' && $sideName === $stream->firstCloser && $ackSet && $ack === $stream->f2) {
            $next = 'CLOSED';
        }
        if ($next !== $stream->state) {
            $stream->state = $next;
            $stream->history[] = [$next, $packet->number];
        }
        $side->packets++;
        $side->payload += $length;
        $stream->packets++;
        $stream->bytes += $packet->length;
        $stream->end = $packet->time;
    }
    return $streams;
}

function addConversation(array &$conversations, string $kind, string $key, mixed $source, mixed $destination, object $packet): void
{
    $id = $kind . '|' . $key;
    if (!isset($conversations[$id])) {
        $conversations[$id] = (object) ['kind' => $kind, 'a' => $source, 'b' => $destination, 'first' => $packet->number,
            'start' => $packet->time, 'end' => $packet->time, 'packets' => 0, 'bytes' => 0,
            'abPackets' => 0, 'abBytes' => 0, 'baPackets' => 0, 'baBytes' => 0];
    }
    $item = $conversations[$id];
    $forward = $kind === 'ipv4' ? $source === $item->a : endpointKey($source) === endpointKey($item->a);
    $packetField = $forward ? 'abPackets' : 'baPackets';
    $byteField = $forward ? 'abBytes' : 'baBytes';
    $item->$packetField++;
    $item->$byteField += $packet->length;
    $item->packets++;
    $item->bytes += $packet->length;
    $item->end = $packet->time;
}

function addEndpoint(array &$endpoints, int $address, string $direction, int $length): void
{
    if (!isset($endpoints[$address])) {
        $endpoints[$address] = (object) ['address' => $address, 'packets' => 0, 'bytes' => 0,
            'txPackets' => 0, 'txBytes' => 0, 'rxPackets' => 0, 'rxBytes' => 0];
    }
    $item = $endpoints[$address];
    $packetField = $direction . 'Packets';
    $byteField = $direction . 'Bytes';
    $item->$packetField++;
    $item->$byteField += $length;
    $item->packets++;
    $item->bytes += $length;
}

function aggregate(array $packets): object
{
    $conversations = [];
    $endpoints = [];
    foreach ($packets as $packet) {
        $source = getField($packet, 'ip.src');
        if ($source === null) {
            continue;
        }
        $destination = getField($packet, 'ip.dst');
        addConversation($conversations, 'ipv4', min($source, $destination) . ':' . max($source, $destination), $source, $destination, $packet);
        addEndpoint($endpoints, $source, 'tx', $packet->length);
        addEndpoint($endpoints, $destination, 'rx', $packet->length);
        if (getField($packet, 'tcp.stream') !== null) {
            addConversation($conversations, 'tcp', (string) getField($packet, 'tcp.stream'), [$source, getField($packet, 'tcp.srcport')],
                [$destination, getField($packet, 'tcp.dstport')], $packet);
        }
        if (getField($packet, 'udp.srcport') !== null) {
            $first = [$source, getField($packet, 'udp.srcport')];
            $second = [$destination, getField($packet, 'udp.dstport')];
            addConversation($conversations, 'udp', pairKey($first, $second), $first, $second, $packet);
        }
    }
    $conversations = array_values($conversations);
    $endpoints = array_values($endpoints);
    $kinds = ['ipv4' => 0, 'tcp' => 1, 'udp' => 2];
    usort($conversations, fn($a, $b) => ($b->bytes <=> $a->bytes) ?: ($b->packets <=> $a->packets)
        ?: ($kinds[$a->kind] <=> $kinds[$b->kind]) ?: ($a->first <=> $b->first));
    usort($endpoints, fn($a, $b) => ($b->bytes <=> $a->bytes) ?: ($b->packets <=> $a->packets) ?: ($a->address <=> $b->address));
    return (object) ['conversations' => $conversations, 'endpoints' => $endpoints];
}

<?php

function readCapture(string $filename): array
{
    $packets = [];
    $packet = null;
    $finish = function () use (&$packet, &$packets): void {
        if ($packet === null) {
            return;
        }
        if ($packet->reason === null && count($packet->bytes) !== $packet->length) {
            $packet->reason = 'dump: length mismatch (header ' . $packet->length . ', data ' . count($packet->bytes) . ')';
        }
        $packets[] = $packet;
    };
    foreach (file($filename, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $index => $line) {
        if (str_starts_with($line, 'PACKET ')) {
            $finish();
            [, $number, $time, $length] = explode(' ', $line);
            $packet = (object) ['number' => (int) $number, 'time' => (int) $time, 'length' => (int) $length,
                'bytes' => [], 'reason' => null];
        } elseif ($line !== '' && $packet->reason === null) {
            if (!preg_match('/\A([0-9a-f]{4})  ([0-9a-f]{2}(?: [0-9a-f]{2}){0,15})\z/', $line, $match)) {
                $packet->reason = 'dump: bad line ' . ($index + 1);
            } elseif (hexdec($match[1]) !== count($packet->bytes)) {
                $packet->reason = 'dump: offset mismatch at line ' . ($index + 1);
            } else {
                foreach (explode(' ', $match[2]) as $byte) {
                    $packet->bytes[] = hexdec($byte);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    $finish();
    return $packets;
}

function dumpLines(array $bytes): array
{
    $lines = [];
    for ($offset = 0; $offset < count($bytes); $offset += 16) {
        $piece = array_slice($bytes, $offset, 16);
        $hex = implode(' ', array_map(fn($byte) => sprintf('%02x', $byte), $piece));
        $characters = '';
        foreach ($piece as $byte) {
            $characters .= $byte >= 32 && $byte <= 126 ? chr($byte) : '.';
        }
        $lines[] = sprintf('%04x', $offset) . '  ' . str_pad($hex, 47) . '  |' . $characters . '|';
    }
    return $lines;
}

<?php

class Malformed extends RuntimeException {}

function uint(array $bytes, int $offset, int $count = 2): int
{
    $value = 0;
    for ($index = $offset; $index < $offset + $count; $index++) {
        $value = $value * 256 + $bytes[$index];
    }
    return $value;
}

function integerBytes(int $value, int $count): array
{
    $bytes = array_fill(0, $count, 0);
    for ($index = $count - 1; $index >= 0; $index--) {
        $bytes[$index] = $value % 256;
        $value = intdiv($value, 256);
    }
    return $bytes;
}

function checksum(array $bytes): string
{
    $total = 0;
    for ($index = 0; $index < count($bytes); $index += 2) {
        $total += $bytes[$index] * 256 + ($bytes[$index + 1] ?? 0);
    }
    while ($total > 65535) {
        $total = $total % 65536 + intdiv($total, 65536);
    }
    return $total === 65535 ? 'good' : 'bad';
}

function mac(int $value): string
{
    return implode(':', array_map(fn($byte) => sprintf('%02x', $byte), integerBytes($value, 6)));
}

function ipv4(int $value): string
{
    return implode('.', integerBytes($value, 4));
}

function ethernet(array $bytes): object
{
    if (count($bytes) < 14) {
        throw new Malformed('eth: truncated');
    }
    return (object) ['fields' => ['eth.dst' => [uint($bytes, 0, 6)], 'eth.src' => [uint($bytes, 6, 6)],
        'eth.type' => [uint($bytes, 12)]], 'payload' => array_slice($bytes, 14)];
}

function arp(array $bytes): object
{
    if (count($bytes) < 28) {
        throw new Malformed('arp: truncated');
    }
    if (uint($bytes, 0) !== 1 || uint($bytes, 2) !== 2048 || $bytes[4] !== 6 || $bytes[5] !== 4) {
        throw new Malformed('arp: unsupported format');
    }
    return (object) ['fields' => ['arp.opcode' => [uint($bytes, 6)], 'arp.src.hw' => [uint($bytes, 8, 6)],
        'arp.src.ip' => [uint($bytes, 14, 4)], 'arp.dst.hw' => [uint($bytes, 18, 6)], 'arp.dst.ip' => [uint($bytes, 24, 4)]], 'payload' => []];
}

function ip(array $bytes): object
{
    if (count($bytes) < 20) {
        throw new Malformed('ip: truncated header');
    }
    $version = intdiv($bytes[0], 16);
    if ($version !== 4) {
        throw new Malformed('ip: bad version ' . $version);
    }
    $header = ($bytes[0] % 16) * 4;
    if ($header < 20) {
        throw new Malformed('ip: bad header length ' . $header);
    }
    if (count($bytes) < $header) {
        throw new Malformed('ip: truncated header');
    }
    $length = uint($bytes, 2);
    if ($length < $header) {
        throw new Malformed('ip: bad total length ' . $length);
    }
    if ($length > count($bytes)) {
        throw new Malformed('ip: truncated (total length ' . $length . ', available ' . count($bytes) . ')');
    }
    $flags = uint($bytes, 6);
    $more = intdiv($flags, 8192) % 2;
    $offset = ($flags % 8192) * 8;
    $fields = ['ip.hdr_len' => [$header], 'ip.tos' => [$bytes[1]], 'ip.len' => [$length], 'ip.id' => [uint($bytes, 4)],
        'ip.flags.df' => [intdiv($flags, 16384) % 2], 'ip.flags.mf' => [$more], 'ip.frag_offset' => [$offset],
        'ip.ttl' => [$bytes[8]], 'ip.proto' => [$bytes[9]], 'ip.checksum' => [uint($bytes, 10)],
        'ip.checksum.status' => [checksum(array_slice($bytes, 0, $header))], 'ip.src' => [uint($bytes, 12, 4)], 'ip.dst' => [uint($bytes, 16, 4)]];
    if ($more === 1 || $offset !== 0) {
        $fields['ip.fragment'] = [true];
    }
    return (object) ['fields' => $fields, 'payload' => array_slice($bytes, $header, $length - $header)];
}

<?php

require_once __DIR__ . '/hexdump.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/link_network.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/transport.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/dns_app.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/flows.php';

const FIELD_ORDER = [
    ['frame.number', 'integer'], ['frame.time', 'integer'], ['frame.len', 'integer'],
    ['frame.protocols', 'string'], ['frame.malformed', 'string'], ['frame.bad_checksum', 'presence'],
    ['eth.dst', 'MAC'], ['eth.src', 'MAC'], ['eth.type', 'hex4'],
    ['arp.opcode', 'integer'], ['arp.src.hw', 'MAC'], ['arp.src.ip', 'IPv4'], ['arp.dst.hw', 'MAC'], ['arp.dst.ip', 'IPv4'],
    ['ip.hdr_len', 'integer'], ['ip.tos', 'hex2'], ['ip.len', 'integer'], ['ip.id', 'hex4'],
    ['ip.flags.df', 'integer'], ['ip.flags.mf', 'integer'], ['ip.frag_offset', 'integer'],
    ['ip.ttl', 'integer'], ['ip.proto', 'integer'], ['ip.checksum', 'hex4'], ['ip.checksum.status', 'string'],
    ['ip.src', 'IPv4'], ['ip.dst', 'IPv4'], ['ip.fragment', 'presence'],
    ['icmp.type', 'integer'], ['icmp.code', 'integer'], ['icmp.checksum', 'hex4'],
    ['icmp.checksum.status', 'string'], ['icmp.id', 'integer'], ['icmp.seq', 'integer'],
    ['udp.srcport', 'integer'], ['udp.dstport', 'integer'], ['udp.length', 'integer'],
    ['udp.checksum', 'hex4'], ['udp.checksum.status', 'string'],
    ['tcp.srcport', 'integer'], ['tcp.dstport', 'integer'], ['tcp.stream', 'integer'],
    ['tcp.seq', 'integer'], ['tcp.seq_raw', 'integer'], ['tcp.ack', 'integer'], ['tcp.ack_raw', 'integer'],
    ['tcp.hdr_len', 'integer'], ['tcp.flags', 'hex2'], ['tcp.flags.fin', 'integer'], ['tcp.flags.syn', 'integer'],
    ['tcp.flags.rst', 'integer'], ['tcp.flags.psh', 'integer'], ['tcp.flags.ack', 'integer'], ['tcp.flags.urg', 'integer'],
    ['tcp.window', 'integer'], ['tcp.window.calc', 'integer'], ['tcp.checksum', 'hex4'],
    ['tcp.checksum.status', 'string'], ['tcp.urgent', 'integer'], ['tcp.option', 'string'],
    ['tcp.options.mss', 'integer'], ['tcp.options.wscale', 'integer'], ['tcp.options.malformed', 'presence'],
    ['tcp.len', 'integer'], ['tcp.analysis.retransmission', 'presence'], ['tcp.analysis.out_of_order', 'presence'],
    ['tcp.analysis.lost_segment', 'presence'], ['tcp.analysis.duplicate_ack', 'presence'],
    ['dns.id', 'hex4'], ['dns.flags', 'hex4'], ['dns.flags.response', 'integer'],
    ['dns.flags.opcode', 'integer'], ['dns.flags.rcode', 'integer'], ['dns.count.queries', 'integer'],
    ['dns.count.answers', 'integer'], ['dns.count.auth_rr', 'integer'], ['dns.count.add_rr', 'integer'],
    ['dns.qry.name', 'string'], ['dns.qry.type', 'integer'], ['dns.answer', 'string'],
    ['dns.authority', 'string'], ['dns.additional', 'string'], ['dns.a', 'IPv4'], ['data.len', 'integer']
];
const ALIASES = ['eth.addr' => ['eth.dst', 'eth.src'], 'ip.addr' => ['ip.src', 'ip.dst'],
    'udp.port' => ['udp.srcport', 'udp.dstport'], 'tcp.port' => ['tcp.srcport', 'tcp.dstport']];
const PROTOCOLS = ['eth', 'arp', 'ip', 'icmp', 'udp', 'tcp', 'dns', 'data'];
const CHECKSUMS = [['ip', 'IPv4'], ['icmp', 'ICMP'], ['udp', 'UDP'], ['tcp', 'TCP']];
const COMPARISONS = ['==', '!=', '<', '>', '<=', '>='];

function fieldTypes(): array
{
    static $types = null;
    if ($types === null) {
        $types = [];
        foreach (FIELD_ORDER as [$name, $type]) {
            $types[$name] = $type;
        }
        foreach (ALIASES as $name => $members) {
            $types[$name] = $types[$members[0]];
        }
        foreach (PROTOCOLS as $name) {
            $types[$name] = 'presence';
        }
    }
    return $types;
}

function seconds(int $time): string
{
    return intdiv($time, 1000000) . '.' . sprintf('%06d', $time % 1000000);
}

function notation(string $type, mixed $value): string
{
    if ($type === 'hex2' || $type === 'hex4') {
        return '0x' . str_pad(dechex($value), $type === 'hex2' ? 2 : 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }
    if ($type === 'MAC') {
        return mac($value);
    }
    if ($type === 'IPv4') {
        return ipv4($value);
    }
    return (string) $value;
}

function dissectPacket(object $packet, int $firstTime): void
{
    $packet->fields = [];
    $packet->layers = [];
    $packet->remaining = [];
    $packet->dnsAnswers = [];
    $payload = $packet->bytes;
    $layer = $packet->reason === null ? 'eth' : null;
    while ($layer !== null) {
        $packet->layers[] = $layer;
        try {
            if ($layer === 'eth') {
                $result = ethernet($payload);
            } elseif ($layer === 'arp') {
                $result = arp($payload);
            } elseif ($layer === 'ip') {
                $result = ip($payload);
            } elseif ($layer === 'icmp') {
                $result = icmp($payload);
            } elseif ($layer === 'udp') {
                $result = udp($payload, getField($packet, 'ip.src'), getField($packet, 'ip.dst'));
            } elseif ($layer === 'tcp') {
                $result = tcp($payload, getField($packet, 'ip.src'), getField($packet, 'ip.dst'));
            } else {
                $result = (new DnsReader($payload))->dissect();
            }
        } catch (Malformed $error) {
            $packet->reason = $error->getMessage();
            break;
        }
        $packet->fields = array_merge($packet->fields, $result->fields);
        $payload = $result->payload;
        if ($layer === 'eth') {
            $type = getField($packet, 'eth.type');
            $layer = $type === 2054 ? 'arp' : ($type === 2048 ? 'ip' : null);
        } elseif ($layer === 'ip') {
            $protocol = getField($packet, 'ip.proto');
            $layer = getField($packet, 'ip.fragment') !== null ? null
                : ($protocol === 1 ? 'icmp' : ($protocol === 17 ? 'udp' : ($protocol === 6 ? 'tcp' : null)));
        } elseif ($layer === 'udp') {
            $layer = getField($packet, 'udp.srcport') === 53 || getField($packet, 'udp.dstport') === 53 ? 'dns' : null;
        } else {
            if ($layer === 'dns') {
                $packet->dnsAnswers = $result->answers;
            }
            $layer = null;
        }
    }
    if ($packet->reason === null && count($payload) > 0) {
        $packet->layers[] = 'data';
        $packet->fields['data.len'] = [count($payload)];
        $packet->remaining = $payload;
    }
    $packet->fields['frame.number'] = [$packet->number];
    $packet->fields['frame.time'] = [$packet->time - $firstTime];
    $packet->fields['frame.len'] = [$packet->length];
    if ($packet->layers) {
        $packet->fields['frame.protocols'] = [implode(':', $packet->layers)];
    }
    if ($packet->reason !== null) {
        $packet->fields['frame.malformed'] = [$packet->reason];
    }
    foreach (CHECKSUMS as [$name]) {
        if (getField($packet, $name . '.checksum.status') === 'bad') {
            $packet->fields['frame.bad_checksum'] = [true];
            break;
        }
    }
}

function tcpInfo(object $packet): string
{
    $prefix = match ($packet->mark) {
        'retransmission' => '[TCP Retransmission] ',
        'out_of_order' => '[TCP Out-Of-Order] ',
        'lost_segment' => '[TCP Previous segment not captured] ',
        'duplicate_ack' => '[TCP Dup ACK ' . $packet->duplicateAck->original . '#' . $packet->duplicateAck->count . '] ',
        default => ''
    };
    $flags = [];
    foreach (['FIN', 'SYN', 'RST', 'PSH', 'ACK', 'URG', 'ECE', 'CWR'] as $index => $name) {
        if (intdiv(getField($packet, 'tcp.flags'), 2 ** $index) % 2 === 1) {
            $flags[] = $name;
        }
    }
    $text = $prefix . getField($packet, 'tcp.srcport') . ' -> ' . getField($packet, 'tcp.dstport') . ' ['
        . ($flags ? implode(', ', $flags) : '<None>') . '] Seq=' . getField($packet, 'tcp.seq');
    if (getField($packet, 'tcp.flags.ack') === 1) {
        $text .= ' Ack=' . getField($packet, 'tcp.ack');
    }
    $text .= ' Win=' . getField($packet, 'tcp.window.calc') . ' Len=' . getField($packet, 'tcp.len');
    foreach ($packet->fields['tcp.option'] ?? [] as $option) {
        $parts = explode(' ', $option);
        if ($parts[0] === 'MSS') {
            $text .= ' MSS=' . $parts[1];
        } elseif ($parts[0] === 'WS') {
            $text .= ' WS=' . (2 ** (int) $parts[1]);
        } elseif ($parts[0] === 'SACK_PERM') {
            $text .= ' SACK_PERM';
        } elseif ($parts[0] === 'TS') {
            $text .= ' TSval=' . $parts[1] . ' TSecr=' . $parts[2];
        }
    }
    return $text;
}

function dnsInfo(object $packet): string
{
    $text = getField($packet, 'dns.flags.response') === 1 ? 'Response' : 'Query';
    $text .= ' ' . notation('hex4', getField($packet, 'dns.id'));
    $rcode = getField($packet, 'dns.flags.rcode');
    if ($rcode !== 0) {
        $text .= ' ' . rcodeName($rcode);
    }
    $names = $packet->fields['dns.qry.name'] ?? [];
    $types = $packet->fields['dns.qry.type'] ?? [];
    foreach ($names as $index => $name) {
        $text .= ' ' . typeName($types[$index]) . ' ' . $name;
    }
    foreach ($packet->dnsAnswers as $answer) {
        $text .= ' ' . typeName($answer->type) . ' ' . $answer->text;
    }
    return $text;
}

function summaryLine(object $packet): string
{
    $types = fieldTypes();
    $value = fn($name) => notation($types[$name], getField($packet, $name));
    $source = '-';
    $destination = '-';
    if (getField($packet, 'ip.src') !== null) {
        $source = $value('ip.src');
        $destination = $value('ip.dst');
    } elseif (getField($packet, 'eth.src') !== null) {
        $source = $value('eth.src');
        $destination = $value('eth.dst');
    }
    $layers = array_values(array_filter($packet->layers, fn($name) => $name !== 'data'));
    $lastLayer = $layers ? $layers[count($layers) - 1] : null;
    $protocol = ['eth' => 'ETH', 'arp' => 'ARP', 'ip' => 'IPv4', 'icmp' => 'ICMP', 'udp' => 'UDP', 'tcp' => 'TCP', 'dns' => 'DNS'][$lastLayer] ?? 'DUMP';
    $info = $packet->reason;
    if ($info === null) {
        if ($lastLayer === 'eth') {
            $info = 'EtherType ' . $value('eth.type');
        } elseif ($lastLayer === 'arp') {
            $opcode = getField($packet, 'arp.opcode');
            $info = $opcode === 1 ? 'Who has ' . $value('arp.dst.ip') . '? Tell ' . $value('arp.src.ip')
                : ($opcode === 2 ? $value('arp.src.ip') . ' is at ' . $value('arp.src.hw') : 'Opcode ' . $opcode);
        } elseif ($lastLayer === 'ip') {
            $info = getField($packet, 'ip.fragment') === null ? 'Protocol ' . $value('ip.proto')
                : 'Fragment id=' . $value('ip.id') . ' off=' . $value('ip.frag_offset') . (getField($packet, 'ip.flags.mf') === 1 ? ' MF' : '');
        } elseif ($lastLayer === 'icmp') {
            $type = getField($packet, 'icmp.type');
            $info = $type === 0 || $type === 8 ? 'Echo ' . ($type === 8 ? 'request' : 'reply') . ' id=' . $value('icmp.id') . ' seq=' . $value('icmp.seq')
                : 'Type ' . $type . ' code ' . $value('icmp.code');
        } elseif ($lastLayer === 'udp') {
            $info = $value('udp.srcport') . ' -> ' . $value('udp.dstport') . ' Len=' . (getField($packet, 'udp.length') - 8);
        } elseif ($lastLayer === 'tcp') {
            $info = tcpInfo($packet);
        } elseif ($lastLayer === 'dns') {
            $info = dnsInfo($packet);
        }
    }
    if (getField($packet, 'tcp.options.malformed') !== null) {
        $info .= ' [bad TCP options]';
    }
    foreach (CHECKSUMS as [$name, $label]) {
        if (getField($packet, $name . '.checksum.status') === 'bad') {
            $info .= ' [bad ' . $label . ' checksum]';
        }
    }
    return $packet->number . ' ' . seconds(getField($packet, 'frame.time')) . ' ' . $source . ' -> ' . $destination . ' ' . $protocol . ' ' . $packet->length . ' ' . $info;
}

class FilterError extends RuntimeException {}

function tokenizeFilter(string $expression): array
{
    $tokens = [];
    $keywords = ['and' => '&&', 'or' => '||', 'not' => '!'];
    $pairs = ['==', '!=', '<=', '>=', '&&', '||'];
    $index = 0;
    $length = strlen($expression);
    while ($index < $length) {
        $character = $expression[$index];
        if ($character === ' ') {
            $index++;
            continue;
        }
        $column = $index + 1;
        $pair = substr($expression, $index, 2);
        if (in_array($pair, $pairs, true)) {
            $tokens[] = ['kind' => $pair, 'text' => $pair, 'column' => $column];
            $index += 2;
        } elseif (str_contains('()!<>', $character)) {
            $tokens[] = ['kind' => $character, 'text' => $character, 'column' => $column];
            $index++;
        } elseif ($character === '"') {
            $end = strpos($expression, '"', $index + 1);
            if ($end === false) {
                throw new FilterError('unterminated string at column ' . $column);
            }
            $tokens[] = ['kind' => 'string', 'text' => substr($expression, $index, $end - $index + 1), 'column' => $column];
            $index = $end + 1;
        } elseif (preg_match('/[A-Za-z0-9._:]/', $character)) {
            $start = $index;
            while ($index < $length && preg_match('/[A-Za-z0-9._:]/', $expression[$index])) {
                $index++;
            }
            $text = substr($expression, $start, $index - $start);
            $tokens[] = ['kind' => $keywords[$text] ?? 'word', 'text' => $text, 'column' => $column];
        } else {
            throw new FilterError("invalid character '" . $character . "' at column " . $column);
        }
    }
    return $tokens;
}

function convertValue(array $token, string $type, string $field): mixed
{
    $text = $token['text'];
    if ($type === 'string' && $token['kind'] === 'string') {
        return substr($text, 1, -1);
    }
    if ($token['kind'] === 'word') {
        if (in_array($type, ['integer', 'hex2', 'hex4'], true)) {
            if (preg_match('/\A[0-9]{1,15}\z/', $text)) {
                return (int) $text;
            }
            if (preg_match('/\A0x[0-9a-fA-F]{1,12}\z/', $text)) {
                return hexdec(substr($text, 2));
            }
        }
        if ($type === 'IPv4') {
            $parts = explode('.', $text);
            if (count($parts) === 4) {
                $value = 0;
                $valid = true;
                foreach ($parts as $part) {
                    if (!preg_match('/\A[0-9]{1,3}\z/', $part) || (int) $part > 255) {
                        $valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    $value = $value * 256 + (int) $part;
                }
                if ($valid) {
                    return $value;
                }
            }
        }
        if ($type === 'MAC') {
            $parts = explode(':', $text);
            if (count($parts) === 6) {
                $value = 0;
                $valid = true;
                foreach ($parts as $part) {
                    if (!preg_match('/\A[0-9a-fA-F]{2}\z/', $part)) {
                        $valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    $value = $value * 256 + hexdec($part);
                }
                if ($valid) {
                    return $value;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    throw new FilterError('invalid value ' . $text . ' for ' . $field);
}

class FilterParser
{
    private array $tokens;
    private int $index = 0;

    public function __construct(string $expression)
    {
        $this->tokens = tokenizeFilter($expression);
    }

    private function take(): array
    {
        if ($this->index === count($this->tokens)) {
            throw new FilterError('unexpected end of filter');
        }
        return $this->tokens[$this->index++];
    }

    private function unexpected(array $token): void
    {
        throw new FilterError("unexpected '" . $token['text'] . "' at column " . $token['column']);
    }

    private function expression(): object
    {
        $node = $this->product();
        while (($this->tokens[$this->index]['kind'] ?? null) === '||') {
            $this->index++;
            $node = (object) ['kind' => 'or', 'left' => $node, 'right' => $this->product()];
        }
        return $node;
    }

    private function product(): object
    {
        $node = $this->negation();
        while (($this->tokens[$this->index]['kind'] ?? null) === '&&') {
            $this->index++;
            $node = (object) ['kind' => 'and', 'left' => $node, 'right' => $this->negation()];
        }
        return $node;
    }

    private function negation(): object
    {
        if (($this->tokens[$this->index]['kind'] ?? null) === '!') {
            $this->index++;
            return (object) ['kind' => 'not', 'child' => $this->negation()];
        }
        $token = $this->take();
        if ($token['kind'] === '(') {
            $node = $this->expression();
            $close = $this->take();
            if ($close['kind'] !== ')') {
                $this->unexpected($close);
            }
            return $node;
        }
        if ($token['kind'] !== 'word') {
            $this->unexpected($token);
        }
        $field = $token['text'];
        $types = fieldTypes();
        if (!isset($types[$field])) {
            throw new FilterError('unknown field ' . $field);
        }
        $type = $types[$field];
        if (!in_array($this->tokens[$this->index]['kind'] ?? null, COMPARISONS, true)) {
            return (object) ['kind' => 'test', 'field' => $field, 'operator' => null];
        }
        $operator = $this->take()['kind'];
        if ($type === 'presence' || ($type === 'string' && $operator !== '==' && $operator !== '!=')) {
            throw new FilterError('operator ' . $operator . ' not allowed for ' . $field);
        }
        $literal = $this->take();
        if ($literal['kind'] !== 'word' && $literal['kind'] !== 'string') {
            $this->unexpected($literal);
        }
        return (object) ['kind' => 'test', 'field' => $field, 'operator' => $operator, 'value' => convertValue($literal, $type, $field)];
    }

    public function parse(): object
    {
        $result = $this->expression();
        if ($this->index < count($this->tokens)) {
            $this->unexpected($this->tokens[$this->index]);
        }
        return $result;
    }
}

function fieldValues(object $packet, string $field): array
{
    if (isset(ALIASES[$field])) {
        return array_merge($packet->fields[ALIASES[$field][0]] ?? [], $packet->fields[ALIASES[$field][1]] ?? []);
    }
    if (in_array($field, PROTOCOLS, true)) {
        return in_array($field, $packet->layers, true) ? [true] : [];
    }
    return $packet->fields[$field] ?? [];
}

function matchesFilter(object $node, object $packet): bool
{
    if ($node->kind === 'or') {
        return matchesFilter($node->left, $packet) || matchesFilter($node->right, $packet);
    }
    if ($node->kind === 'and') {
        return matchesFilter($node->left, $packet) && matchesFilter($node->right, $packet);
    }
    if ($node->kind === 'not') {
        return !matchesFilter($node->child, $packet);
    }
    $values = fieldValues($packet, $node->field);
    if ($node->operator === null) {
        return count($values) > 0;
    }
    if (!$values) {
        return false;
    }
    if ($node->operator === '!=') {
        foreach ($values as $value) {
            if ($value === $node->value) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    foreach ($values as $value) {
        $match = match ($node->operator) {
            '==' => $value === $node->value,
            '<' => $value < $node->value,
            '>' => $value > $node->value,
            '<=' => $value <= $node->value,
            '>=' => $value >= $node->value
        };
        if ($match) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

function readRequests(string $filename): object
{
    $filters = [];
    $details = [];
    foreach (file($filename, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $line) {
        if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
            continue;
        }
        if (str_starts_with($line, 'FILTER ')) {
            $filters[] = substr($line, 7);
        } else {
            $details[] = (int) substr($line, 7);
        }
    }
    return (object) ['filters' => $filters, 'details' => $details];
}

function summaryLines(array $packets, array $filters): array
{
    $lines = array_map(fn($packet) => $packet->summary, $packets);
    foreach ($filters as $filter) {
        $lines[] = '';
        $lines[] = 'filter ' . $filter;
        try {
            $expression = (new FilterParser($filter))->parse();
        } catch (FilterError $error) {
            $lines[] = 'error: ' . $error->getMessage();
            continue;
        }
        $count = 0;
        foreach ($packets as $packet) {
            if (matchesFilter($expression, $packet)) {
                $lines[] = $packet->summary;
                $count++;
            }
        }
        $lines[] = 'matched ' . $count . ' of ' . count($packets);
    }
    return $lines;
}

function detailLines(array $packets, array $requests): array
{
    $lines = [];
    foreach ($requests as $number) {
        if ($lines) {
            $lines[] = '';
        }
        if ($number < 1 || $number > count($packets)) {
            $lines[] = 'packet ' . $number . ' not found';
            continue;
        }
        $packet = $packets[$number - 1];
        $lines[] = 'packet ' . $packet->number;
        foreach (array_merge(['frame'], $packet->layers) as $layer) {
            $lines[] = $layer;
            foreach (FIELD_ORDER as [$name, $type]) {
                if (!str_starts_with($name, $layer . '.')) {
                    continue;
                }
                foreach ($packet->fields[$name] ?? [] as $value) {
                    $lines[] = $type === 'presence' ? '  ' . $name : '  ' . $name . ' = ' . notation($type, $value);
                }
            }
            if ($layer === 'data') {
                foreach (dumpLines($packet->remaining) as $line) {
                    $lines[] = '  ' . $line;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return $lines;
}

function dnsTransactions(array $packets): object
{
    $pending = [];
    $transactions = [];
    $names = [];
    $rcodes = array_fill(0, 16, 0);
    $queries = 0;
    $responses = 0;
    foreach ($packets as $packet) {
        if (getField($packet, 'dns.id') === null) {
            continue;
        }
        if (getField($packet, 'dns.flags.response') === 0) {
            $queries++;
            $pending[] = $packet;
            foreach ($packet->fields['dns.qry.name'] ?? [] as $name) {
                $names[$name] = ($names[$name] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        } else {
            $responses++;
            $rcodes[getField($packet, 'dns.flags.rcode')]++;
            foreach ($pending as $index => $query) {
                if (getField($query, 'dns.id') === getField($packet, 'dns.id')
                    && getField($query, 'ip.src') === getField($packet, 'ip.dst')
                    && getField($query, 'udp.srcport') === getField($packet, 'udp.dstport')
                    && getField($query, 'ip.dst') === getField($packet, 'ip.src')
                    && getField($query, 'udp.dstport') === getField($packet, 'udp.srcport')) {
                    $transactions[] = $packet->time - $query->time;
                    array_splice($pending, $index, 1);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return (object) compact('queries', 'responses', 'pending', 'transactions', 'names', 'rcodes');
}

function protocolLines(array $packets, object $dnsStats): array
{
    $hierarchy = [];
    foreach (PROTOCOLS as $name) {
        $hierarchy[$name] = ['packets' => 0, 'bytes' => 0];
    }
    $checksums = [];
    foreach (CHECKSUMS as [$name]) {
        $checksums[$name] = ['good' => 0, 'bad' => 0, 'none' => 0];
    }
    $malformed = array_fill_keys(['dump', 'eth', 'arp', 'ip', 'icmp', 'udp', 'tcp', 'dns'], 0);
    $marks = array_fill_keys(MARKS, 0);
    $bytes = 0;
    foreach ($packets as $packet) {
        $bytes += $packet->length;
        foreach ($packet->layers as $layer) {
            $hierarchy[$layer]['packets']++;
            $hierarchy[$layer]['bytes'] += $packet->length;
        }
        foreach (CHECKSUMS as [$name]) {
            $status = getField($packet, $name . '.checksum.status');
            if ($status !== null) {
                $checksums[$name][$status]++;
            }
        }
        if ($packet->reason !== null) {
            $last = $packet->layers ? $packet->layers[count($packet->layers) - 1] : 'dump';
            $malformed[$last]++;
        }
        if (($packet->mark ?? null) !== null) {
            $marks[$packet->mark]++;
        }
    }
    $lines = ['packets ' . count($packets), 'bytes ' . $bytes,
        'duration ' . seconds($packets[count($packets) - 1]->time - $packets[0]->time), 'hierarchy'];
    foreach ([['eth', 0], ['arp', 2], ['ip', 2], ['icmp', 4], ['udp', 4], ['dns', 6], ['tcp', 4]] as [$name, $indent]) {
        $item = $hierarchy[$name];
        $lines[] = str_repeat(' ', $indent) . $name . ' ' . $item['packets'] . ' ' . $item['bytes'];
    }
    $lines[] = 'checksums';
    foreach (CHECKSUMS as [$name]) {
        $item = $checksums[$name];
        $lines[] = $name . ' good ' . $item['good'] . ' bad ' . $item['bad'] . ($name === 'udp' ? ' none ' . $item['none'] : '');
    }
    $lines[] = 'malformed';
    foreach (['dump', 'eth', 'arp', 'ip', 'icmp', 'udp', 'tcp', 'dns'] as $name) {
        $lines[] = $name . ' ' . $malformed[$name];
    }
    $lines[] = 'tcp analysis';
    foreach (MARKS as $name) {
        $lines[] = $name . ' ' . $marks[$name];
    }
    $lines[] = 'dns';
    $lines[] = 'queries ' . $dnsStats->queries;
    $lines[] = 'responses ' . $dnsStats->responses;
    $lines[] = 'transactions ' . count($dnsStats->transactions);
    $lines[] = 'unanswered ' . count($dnsStats->pending);
    if ($dnsStats->transactions) {
        $lines[] = 'response_time min ' . seconds(min($dnsStats->transactions)) . ' max ' . seconds(max($dnsStats->transactions));
    } else {
        $lines[] = 'response_time -';
    }
    for ($code = 0; $code < 16; $code++) {
        if ($dnsStats->rcodes[$code] !== 0) {
            $lines[] = 'rcode ' . rcodeName($code) . ' ' . $dnsStats->rcodes[$code];
        }
    }
    $lines[] = 'names';
    $names = [];
    foreach ($dnsStats->names as $name => $count) {
        $names[] = [(string) $name, $count];
    }
    usort($names, fn($a, $b) => ($b[1] <=> $a[1]) ?: strcmp($a[0], $b[0]));
    foreach ($names as [$name, $count]) {
        $lines[] = $name . ' ' . $count;
    }
    return $lines;
}

function endpointNotation(array $endpoint): string
{
    return ipv4($endpoint[0]) . ':' . $endpoint[1];
}

function conversationLines(array $conversations, int $firstTime): array
{
    $lines = ['type,endpoint_a,endpoint_b,packets,bytes,packets_a_to_b,bytes_a_to_b,packets_b_to_a,bytes_b_to_a,start,duration'];
    foreach ($conversations as $item) {
        $first = $item->kind === 'ipv4' ? ipv4($item->a) : endpointNotation($item->a);
        $second = $item->kind === 'ipv4' ? ipv4($item->b) : endpointNotation($item->b);
        $lines[] = implode(',', [$item->kind, $first, $second, $item->packets, $item->bytes, $item->abPackets, $item->abBytes,
            $item->baPackets, $item->baBytes, seconds($item->start - $firstTime), seconds($item->end - $item->start)]);
    }
    return $lines;
}

function endpointLines(array $endpoints): array
{
    $lines = ['address,packets,bytes,tx_packets,tx_bytes,rx_packets,rx_bytes'];
    foreach ($endpoints as $item) {
        $lines[] = implode(',', [ipv4($item->address), $item->packets, $item->bytes, $item->txPackets, $item->txBytes, $item->rxPackets, $item->rxBytes]);
    }
    return $lines;
}

function streamLines(array $streams, array $packets): array
{
    $lines = [];
    foreach ($streams as $stream) {
        if ($lines) {
            $lines[] = '';
        }
        $lines[] = 'stream ' . $stream->number . ' ' . endpointNotation($stream->client) . ' -> ' . endpointNotation($stream->server);
        $lines[] = 'packets ' . $stream->packets . ' bytes ' . $stream->bytes . ' start ' . seconds($stream->start - $packets[0]->time)
            . ' duration ' . seconds($stream->end - $stream->start);
        $history = [];
        foreach ($stream->history as [$state, $number]) {
            $history[] = $state . ' ' . $number;
        }
        $lines[] = 'states ' . implode(', ', $history);
        $handshake = $stream->handshake;
        $rtt = $handshake['syn'] !== null && $handshake['ack'] !== null
            ? seconds($packets[$handshake['ack'] - 1]->time - $packets[$handshake['syn'] - 1]->time) : '-';
        $lines[] = 'handshake syn ' . ($handshake['syn'] ?? '-') . ' syn_ack ' . ($handshake['syn_ack'] ?? '-')
            . ' ack ' . ($handshake['ack'] ?? '-') . ' rtt ' . $rtt;
        $client = $stream->sides['client'];
        $server = $stream->sides['server'];
        $lines[] = 'options client mss ' . ($client->mss ?? '-') . ' wscale ' . ($client->ws ?? '-')
            . ' server mss ' . ($server->mss ?? '-') . ' wscale ' . ($server->ws ?? '-');
        foreach (['client', 'server'] as $name) {
            $side = $stream->sides[$name];
            $line = $name . ' packets ' . $side->packets . ' payload ' . $side->payload;
            foreach (MARKS as $mark) {
                $line .= ' ' . $mark . ' ' . $side->counts[$mark];
            }
            $lines[] = $line;
        }
        foreach ($stream->events as [$number, $name, $mark, $seq, $length]) {
            $lines[] = 'event ' . $number . ' ' . $name . ' ' . $mark . ' seq ' . $seq . ' len ' . $length;
        }
    }
    return $lines;
}

function writeLines(string $filename, array $lines): void
{
    file_put_contents('output/' . $filename, $lines ? implode("\n", $lines) . "\n" : '');
}

$packets = readCapture('input/capture.txt');

foreach ($packets as $packet) {

$streams = trackTcp($packets);

require_once __DIR__ . '/link_network.php';

function pseudoHeader(int $source, int $destination, int $protocol, int $length): array
{
    return array_merge(integerBytes($source, 4), integerBytes($destination, 4), [0, $protocol], integerBytes($length, 2));
}

function icmp(array $bytes): object
{
    if (count($bytes) < 8) {
        throw new Malformed('icmp: truncated');
    }
    $fields = ['icmp.type' => [$bytes[0]], 'icmp.code' => [$bytes[1]], 'icmp.checksum' => [uint($bytes, 2)],
        'icmp.checksum.status' => [checksum($bytes)]];
    if ($bytes[0] === 0 || $bytes[0] === 8) {
        $fields['icmp.id'] = [uint($bytes, 4)];
        $fields['icmp.seq'] = [uint($bytes, 6)];
    }
    return (object) ['fields' => $fields, 'payload' => array_slice($bytes, 8)];
}

function udp(array $bytes, int $source, int $destination): object
{
    if (count($bytes) < 8) {
        throw new Malformed('udp: truncated');
    }
    $length = uint($bytes, 4);
    if ($length < 8 || $length > count($bytes)) {
        throw new Malformed('udp: bad length ' . $length);
    }
    $stored = uint($bytes, 6);
    $status = $stored === 0 ? 'none' : checksum(array_merge(pseudoHeader($source, $destination, 17, $length), array_slice($bytes, 0, $length)));
    return (object) ['fields' => ['udp.srcport' => [uint($bytes, 0)], 'udp.dstport' => [uint($bytes, 2)], 'udp.length' => [$length],
        'udp.checksum' => [$stored], 'udp.checksum.status' => [$status]], 'payload' => array_slice($bytes, 8, $length - 8)];
}

function tcpOptions(array $bytes, array &$fields): void
{
    $allowed = [2 => [4], 3 => [3], 4 => [2], 5 => [10, 18, 26, 34], 8 => [10]];
    $recorded = [];
    $index = 0;
    while ($index < count($bytes)) {
        $kind = $bytes[$index];
        if ($kind === 0) {
            $recorded[] = 'EOL';
            break;
        }
        if ($kind === 1) {
            $recorded[] = 'NOP';
            $index++;
            continue;
        }
        $length = $bytes[$index + 1] ?? 0;
        if ($length < 2 || $index + $length > count($bytes) || (isset($allowed[$kind]) && !in_array($length, $allowed[$kind], true))) {
            $fields['tcp.options.malformed'] = [true];
            break;
        }
        $body = array_slice($bytes, $index + 2, $length - 2);
        if ($kind === 2) {
            $value = uint($body, 0);
            $text = 'MSS ' . $value;
            $fields['tcp.options.mss'] = [$value];
        } elseif ($kind === 3) {
            $text = 'WS ' . $body[0];
            $fields['tcp.options.wscale'] = [$body[0]];
        } elseif ($kind === 4) {
            $text = 'SACK_PERM';
        } elseif ($kind === 5) {
            $text = 'SACK';
            for ($position = 0; $position < count($body); $position += 8) {
                $text .= ' ' . uint($body, $position, 4) . '-' . uint($body, $position + 4, 4);
            }
        } elseif ($kind === 8) {
            $text = 'TS ' . uint($body, 0, 4) . ' ' . uint($body, 4, 4);
        } else {
            $text = 'kind ' . $kind . ' len ' . $length;
        }
        $recorded[] = $text;
        $index += $length;
    }
    if ($recorded) {
        $fields['tcp.option'] = $recorded;
    }
}

function tcp(array $bytes, int $source, int $destination): object
{
    if (count($bytes) < 20) {
        throw new Malformed('tcp: truncated header');
    }
    $header = intdiv($bytes[12], 16) * 4;
    if ($header < 20) {
        throw new Malformed('tcp: bad header length ' . $header);
    }
    if ($header > count($bytes)) {
        throw new Malformed('tcp: truncated header');
    }
    $flags = $bytes[13];
    $fields = ['tcp.srcport' => [uint($bytes, 0)], 'tcp.dstport' => [uint($bytes, 2)], 'tcp.seq_raw' => [uint($bytes, 4, 4)],
        'tcp.hdr_len' => [$header], 'tcp.flags' => [$flags], 'tcp.window' => [uint($bytes, 14)], 'tcp.checksum' => [uint($bytes, 16)],
        'tcp.checksum.status' => [checksum(array_merge(pseudoHeader($source, $destination, 6, count($bytes)), $bytes))],
        'tcp.urgent' => [uint($bytes, 18)], 'tcp.len' => [count($bytes) - $header]];
    foreach (['fin', 'syn', 'rst', 'psh', 'ack', 'urg'] as $index => $name) {
        $fields['tcp.flags.' . $name] = [intdiv($flags, 2 ** $index) % 2];
    }
    if ($fields['tcp.flags.ack'][0] === 1) {
        $fields['tcp.ack_raw'] = [uint($bytes, 8, 4)];
    }
    tcpOptions(array_slice($bytes, 20, $header - 20), $fields);
    return (object) ['fields' => $fields, 'payload' => array_slice($bytes, $header)];
}
